newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE PREDICTS DEFEAT FOR LIONS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CAMPESE PREDICTS DEFEAT FOR LIONS.

text.p: David Campese has predicted the British Lions will be crushed by the Springboks in their three-test series in South Africa.
The controversial Australian believes the Lions will be simply outclassed by the reigning world champions.
The world's record try scorer said on Thursday: "If I say it will be 3-0 to South Africa everybody says I'm a typical bloody Aussie, but I honestly can't see the Lions winning the big matches."

Campese, in England to play for the World XV against Wasps at Twickenham, added: "I looked at the Lions squad and there's not a lot of experience there. You haven't got a decent fly-half... it's going to be tough."
